implementation.change: Move the fixed 18px sparkline track height from an inline declaration to the CSS recipe. Dynamic per-bar height calculation is unchanged.

comparisonScope.barDurationComparisonMeaning: Hit-target dimensions, widths and status colors are retained. Fixture run URLs and durations naturally differ across phases.

comparisonNote: Same 18 px track · Real run durations differ.
limits: Layout-only lint refactor: same18px track retained. Dynamic per-bar height code is unchanged.
Independent real runs have naturally different durations, summaries and IDs. Per-run heights are compared against actual duration formula, not asserted identical across phases.

Initial Before read-only capture attempts had an input-text selector mismatch and an output-field handling error. Two early grid/list PNGs, two selector-failure PNGs and an initial running screenshot are retained locally but excluded from publication; no app or harness source was edited.
The first transient deep-link/log inspection accidentally selected ExportJSON, then a read-only dialog snapshot timed out; its local failure PNG is excluded. The stack doctor stayed healthy.
Recordings are normal control-openhands recordings; no pause/resume or clock manipulation. CLI itself compresses unchanged-frame time as reported per clip.

Live evidence covers the four named consumers in standalone Local Canvas, Neutral/Light+/DeepSea, desktop and phone. No authenticated Cloud, ACP, all-five-theme or arbitrary embedded-host visual pass is claimed.
